abstract: Maintains structural stability and passive fire barrier ratings
system_message:
You are the Structural safety surveyor (SSS), responsible for maintaining structural stability assessments and passive fire barrier ratings across prospective national cultural heritage evacuation depositories.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains structural stability and passive fire barrier ratings（STRU）
information_points.content:
SSS-STRU-HIY：At Taunus Granite Fortress Depository, structural fire endurance for vault boundary walls, ceilings, and armored blast doors is certified at 240 min of thermal containment under standard fire curve testing.
SSS-STRU-CCF：Rhine-Westphalia Salt Cavern Archive demonstrates a structural fire endurance of 120 min across its vault boundary walls, ceilings, and armored blast doors based on certified thermal containment testing under the standard fire curve.
SSS-STRU-ZE5：For Bavarian Alpine Subterranean Vault, structural fire endurance testing across vault boundary walls, ceilings, and armored blast doors confirms a certified thermal containment duration of 180 min under standard fire curve conditions.

information_points.title: Acoustic vibration dampening（VIBR）
information_points.content:
SSS-VIBR-R8F：Rhine-Westphalia Salt Cavern Archive exhibits an ambient floor vibration amplitude of 18 um/s on the primary masterwork storage floor slab during daytime freight movement.
SSS-VIBR-0TR：For Bavarian Alpine Subterranean Vault, the ambient floor vibration amplitude measured on the primary masterwork storage floor slab registers a peak root-mean-square vibration velocity of 25 um/s during daytime freight movement.
SSS-VIBR-AWY：At Taunus Granite Fortress Depository, ambient floor vibration amplitude measured on the primary masterwork storage floor slab is 12 um/s in peak root-mean-square vibration velocity during daytime freight movement.
